scientific_limits_retained: One training seed per primary architecture
Bootstrap interval covers sampled paired trials, not independent training variability
BiLSTM has more parameters and lower throughput
Adaptive curricula create different stage exposure
Historical comparisons have unknown training settings
Self-play is supported but not the matched quantitative benchmark
